text:
nora: Quick note - onboarding sample (node) produced a burst of 429s. Repro branch: https://git.redwood.dev/onboard-node (branch: coalesce-jitter)
axel: Root cause?
nora: Prefetch starts 20 page fetches in parallel, one triggers token refresh -> others immediately retry -> 429 avalanche. Logs:
```
[2024-09-03T09:00:01Z] page=1 200
[2024-09-03T09:00:02Z] refresh start
[2024-09-03T09:00:02Z] page=7 429
[2024-09-03T09:00:02Z] retry immediate -> 429
[2024-09-03T09:00:03Z] refresh done
```
priya: Similar patterns in other samples. Quick fixes for sample/app: reuse ApiClient, add a small pagination semaphore (3), and add jittered exponential backoff on 429s.
axel: For SDK: consider adding an opt-in "coalesceRefresh" that single-flights token refreshes and a default small prefetch window.
nora: Patch I used in sample:
```
const sem = pLimit(3)
await Promise.all(pages.map(p => sem(() => client.fetchPage(p))))
// refresh locker
if (refreshPromise) return refreshPromise
refreshPromise = doRefresh().finally(()=> refreshPromise=null)
```
priya: Ops noticed the spike and applied temporary soft-throttle. sentry-bot: quota-shed applied to org:onboard-9 for 60s :warning:
axel: Can you open PRs for sample + SDK defaults and add an e2e that simulates mid-stream token expiry and asserts no >2 concurrent refreshes?
nora: Yep, opening PRs now. Title: "node: prefetch window + coalesced refresh + jittered retries". Assigning to @axel and reviewers @priya. I'll follow up with telemetry next week.
